description: Use this to show which sender domains send the best pitches. Returns one row per sender domain with volume, average scores, yield rate (a 0 to 1 fraction of pitches marked interested) and a recommendation, plus up to 20 recent evaluations from the last 30 days, since older ones are pruned. Pass sender_domain to see one sender; send no arguments for all. Read-only. Errors: no_desk means call set_criteria first with target_role, skills, salary_floor and remote_policy; no_user_id means the client sent no user id, and no argument fixes it: in ChatGPT ask the user to sign in, and in another MCP client connect to https://connect.openkrill.app/plugins/outreach-desk/mcp with OAuth, then call again. When nothing is scored yet the lists are empty; ask the user to paste a pitch for score_message.

sender_domain.description: Optional sender domain to show only one sender, such as "stripe.com". Omit it for all senders.

name: get_scoreboard

as_of.description: Day of the call, as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

recent_evaluations.description: Up to 20 newest evaluations from the last 30 days; older ones are pruned.

created_day.description: Day the pitch was scored, as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

flags.description: Warning flags. Values: missing_salary, dealbreaker_clash, token_failure (unfilled template token such as [Current Company]), aggressive_drip, repeat_after_decline, slop, artificial_urgency, free_webmail. Empty when the pitch is clean.

last_contact_day.description: Day of the latest pitch, as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

recommendation.description: How to treat future pitches from this sender.

volume.description: Pitches scored from this sender since the desk started.

yield_count.description: Pitches from this sender marked interested.

yield_rate.description: yield_count divided by volume, as a 0 to 1 fraction.

source.description: Where the data comes from: the user's own private desk.

summary.description: One-line total; says what to do next when nothing is scored yet.

title: Get Sender Scoreboard
